milestone.title: mp autopilot typed task assignment — orchestrator dispatch through herdr argv

intent.outcome: The orchestrator dispatches every runner or reviewer assignment through one typed renderer that produces and executes a herdr argv invocation, while roles report progress through typed session transitions.

problem.description: The herdr tests showed that prose such as notify the orchestrator is interpreted inconsistently. The enforceable boundary is at dispatch: mp constructs and executes herdr argv itself, records the assignment event, and agents report progress through typed mp session transitions. The receiver cannot prove how arbitrary text was produced, so this milestone does not attempt receiver-side shell-envelope detection.

in_scope: Typed TaskAssignment renderer for orchestrator-to-runner and orchestrator-to-reviewer dispatches, with structured payload fields for session, milestone, cycle, role, task, evidence references, and boundary reminders.
Execution uses argv directly rather than shell interpolation; before invoking herdr, command shape, non-empty payload, target pane membership, and role direction are validated.
Each successful or failed dispatch appends a sequence-numbered event to the M207 session log; agents report state through mp autopilot session transition.
out_of_scope: Lane-to-orchestrator notification parsing; typed session transitions and the orchestrator event loop replace it.
State cross-checking and role-boundary verification, owned by M212.
Cycle sequencing and retry policy, owned by M213.

acceptance_criteria.description: Task-assignment rendering is deterministic for orchestrator-to-runner and orchestrator-to-reviewer, includes session/milestone/cycle/role/evidence fields, and produces an argv vector rather than a shell string.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_task_assignment_golden --no-fail-fast exit 0 (9/9 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Before dispatch, validation rejects empty payloads, unknown target panes, invalid role directions, missing session identity, and shell metacharacter interpolation; no herdr call or session mutation occurs on rejection.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_task_assignment_validation --no-fail-fast exit 0 (28/28 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: A regression fixture reproduces the M200 text-only assignment mistake: only the typed dispatcher can append AssignmentDispatched, and a prose-only or empty assignment is rejected before execution with TaskAssignmentShapeViolation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_task_assignment_m200_regression --no-fail-fast exit 0 (17/17 pass)

design_decisions.choice: Use a typed payload and direct argv execution (`Command` arguments), not a shell command string or hand-rolled key=value parser.
design_decisions.rationale: The sender can enforce argv shape and record dispatch. The receiver cannot prove whether arbitrary text was printed or sent, and shell strings add avoidable quoting risk.

design_decisions.choice: Parser returns a typed error; the orchestrator's state machine (C3) decides whether to resend (3-pane) or escalate (2-pane/1-pane) per the topology-aware decision in B1.
design_decisions.rationale: Separates parsing from decision-making; C1 only owns parsing.
